cues.text: Let's see how to view your child's information.
After you sign in, the dashboard shows a card for each of your children, with a quick summary.
Click Overview on the card to open the full page for that child.
The top shows the photo, class and roll number. The cards below show attendance, fees due, the last exam and days present.
Under Details, choose a page, for example Exam Results, to see marks and grades.
